# The self-test's clean catalogue. Two mutations, one of which nothing in the
# fixture balance source claims, so the uncovered-mutation warning has something
# to find.

mutation alpha
  file    src/Fixture.cs
  from    Alpha = 1
  to      Alpha = 9
  breaks  the first thing, so that a claimed mutation exists

mutation beta
  file    src/Fixture.cs
  from    Beta = 2
  to      Beta = 8
  breaks  the second thing, so that a mutation with no claimant exists
